meta.name: Kohrra 1080p
meta.description:
When an NRI bridegroom is found dead days before his wedding in the countryside of Punjab, two cops must unravel the troubling case as turbulence unfolds in their own lives.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 15 Jul 2023 · India · Language: Hindi · 48 min
Studio: Clean Slate Films · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 6/6

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After a dead body is found, cops Balbir and Garundi uncover links to a wedding and a missing foreigner. A father's grief pulls him down a rageful path.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: An unfolding nightmare traps two families. As cracks grow in Garundi and Balbir's lives, unspoken yearnings emerge. Police chase down new leads.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Nimrat struggles to live under her father's roof. Happy tries to handle a suspicious deal while a brawl involving Paul and Liam sparks new questions.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A sudden confession could close the case, but lingering doubts remain. Balbir seeks companionship and family pressure pushes Garundi to take charge.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A hit-and-run — or murder? Murky details cloud the investigation. Balbir's violent interference in Nimrat's life sends her spiraling into darkness.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Garundi begins a frantic search when Balbir goes missing. Secrets, pride and the tragic cost of love intertwine in the events leading to Paul's death.

videos.title: The Barn
videos.overview: When a young woman is found dead in a barn, Dalerpura police officer Dhanwant Kaur teams up with a newly transferred Garundi as a prime suspect emerges.

videos.title: Three's A Crowd
videos.overview: The officers question Preet's estranged husband who directs them to her brother. As Dhanwant grapples with personal challenges, Garundi heads to Manali.

videos.title: The Dead Never Leave
videos.overview: A flashback reveals Preet and Baljinder's troubled relationship. Homeless Arun searches for his father, Rakesh. Garundi finds a surprise visitor at home.

videos.title: Everything Burns
videos.overview: While visiting the hospital, the cops run into an unsuspecting Baljinder. Dhanwant frantically searches for a loved one. Garundi learns a shocking truth.

videos.title: Hide And Seek
videos.overview: Dhanwant and Garundi investigate a deadly fire linked to a familiar name, while Arun desperately searches for the victims' identities.

videos.title: The Chains That Bind Us
videos.overview: The team looks into the sordid history of the burned-down site. With an arrest already made, could the development upend Preet's case?
